## Why product image alt-text is an ADA/WCAG risk for Shopify and WooCommerce stores

U.S. federal ADA lawsuits over inaccessible websites have targeted thousands of e-commerce stores in recent years, and missing image alt-text is one of the most common — and easiest to prove — findings in a demand letter. Product photos without descriptive alt-text fail WCAG 2.1 Success Criterion 1.1.1 (Non-text Content), which is the baseline most plaintiffs' firms cite. A store with hundreds of product images and zero alt-text is a visible, quantifiable target.

ComplianceSnap scans your live storefront the same way an automated accessibility audit or a plaintiff's firm would: it counts every product image missing alt-text and estimates your exposure with a clear risk tier (low / medium / high), free, in under a minute — no signup required for the scan itself.

## How the free scan works

Paste your store URL above. We crawl your public product pages, check each image's alt attribute for missing or placeholder text (empty strings, filenames, "image1.jpg", etc.), and return a risk tier based on the share of images affected. If issues are found, you can optionally get a full report with AI-suggested alt-text for every flagged image for $9, or a $9/month plan that re-scans weekly and keeps an audit trail.

See also: the full Shopify & WooCommerce ADA compliance checklist , covering the 10 most common findings beyond alt-text, what to do if you already received an ADA demand letter , or how to bulk add alt-text across your whole catalog once you know what's missing.
